title: CloudTrail investigation normalization
description: One already-decoded CloudTrail event per record, eventVersion major 1 with additive minor versions. Parse explicit RFC3339 eventTime, retain original security fields and read events. Does not unroll Records arrays or collect S3. Unknown major versions pass unchanged. Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-record-contents.html
